consequence.statement: A new optional way to configure waypoint pod affinity; nothing existing changes for an operator who does nothing.

assertion.statement: Waypoint pod affinity becomes configurable through a Helm value (text says `.Values.waypoint.affinity`; the release artifact spells the key global.waypoint.affinity).
